description: Validates developer platform stacks for recognised component types, required foundational pillars, golden path completeness, IDP integration, SBOM coverage, and contract-level component uniqueness

rules.description: dev-platform-spec.json must exist, be valid JSON, and declare name and a non-empty components array
Every component type must be in the allowlist of recognised platform component categories. Unknown types may be typos or categories that need standardisation

At least one golden path must be defined. Golden paths are the opinionated developer workflows (e.g. 'create new service', 'deploy to production') that give the platform a unified developer experience. Without them, the platform is a collection of tools without a workflow. Each golden path must have a name and a non-empty steps array. Set skipGoldenPaths: true for exemption

An Internal Developer Portal (IDP) component must be present with a tool field. The IDP is the primary interface through which developers discover services, documentation, and platform capabilities. Without it, platform capabilities are undiscoverable. Set skipIDPCheck: true for exemption

An SBOM component must be present in the platform stack. SBOMs are required for supply chain integrity verification, compliance (EO 14028), and vulnerability tracking when a new CVE is discovered. Set skipSBOM: true with justification for exemption
dev-platform-spec.json must not contain TODO, FIXME, HACK, XXX, or PLACEHOLDER markers. Placeholder component types or tool names cause the platform spec to reference tools that do not exist

The three foundational component types must be present: source-control, ci-cd, and artifact-registry. No component type may appear more than once unless marked multi: true. A platform missing any foundational pillar is incomplete

constraints.no-duplicate-types: each component type must be unique unless multi: true is set
